units: <cite ref="Shabbat 63a:8">Sabb. 63ᵃ</cite> (expl. <cite ref="A01785"><he>אַלָּה</he></cite>) <he>ק׳</he> (Ar. a. Ms. O. <cite ref="S00509"><he>קופל</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Berakhot 58a:14">Ber. 58ᵃ</cite> <he>יהבו ליה ק׳</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 5) they gave him the strap, i.e. gave him the privilege of inflicting punishment; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 362">Yalk. Ez. 362</cite> <he>קיל׳</he>. Ber. l. c. <he>מחייא ליה בקוּלְפֵיה דפרזלא וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>בקולפא</he> only) he struck him with his iron-pointed whip and killed him; Yalk. l. c. <he>בקיל׳</he>.
<cite ref="Ketubot 65a:10">Keth. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>מחתה לה בק׳ דשידא</he> she struck her with the strap of a chest (Ar. <he>בק׳ דשיראי</he> with a silken strap).—Pl. <he>קוּלְפֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 56a:15">Ber. 56ᵃ</cite> <he>תרין ק׳ בלעת</he> thou shalt receive two lashes.
